news.titleEn: Anthropic IPO live updates: AI lab's S-1 filing
news.conclusionEn: Claude maker Anthropic publicly filed an S-1 with the SEC to list on the Nasdaq under the ticker "ANT", disclosing $16.3 billion in first-half 2026 revenue.
news.conclusionZh: Anthropic公开递交上市申请，拟以「ANT」登陆纳斯达克
news.whyEn: It could be one of the largest IPOs ever and the first public look at a frontier AI lab's finances, setting a benchmark for how markets value the AI boom.
news.whyZh: 或成史上最大IPO之一，首次公开AI前沿实验室账本，影响整个AI板块估值
news.detailEn: The prospectus shows revenue of about $16.3 billion for the six months to June 30, up from $1.16 billion a year earlier, alongside a net loss of roughly $80.7 billion. About 80% of revenue is consumption-based, and the company disclosed around $417 billion in future compute obligations. Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley lead the underwriting group, and a single Class F share held by a founders' entity will carry 50.1% of voting power. Trading could begin the week of Nov. 16, according to a Wall Street Journal report, though share count and price range are not yet set.
news.detailZh: 招股书显示，截至6月30日的半年营收约163亿美元，去年同期仅11.6亿美元，但同期净亏损约807亿美元。约80%收入来自按用量计费，公司还披露了约4170亿美元的未来算力支付承诺。承销团由高盛和摩根士丹利牵头，创始人实体持有的一股F类股将掌握50.1%投票权。据《华尔街日报》报道，最快11月16日当周挂牌，发行股数和价格区间尚未确定。

news.titleEn: Stocks close higher as excitement over Anthropic IPO filing propels tech sector: Live updates
news.conclusionEn: U.S. stocks rose on Monday as the Anthropic filing revived the AI trade: the S&P 500 gained 0.70% to 7,676.77 and the Nasdaq rose 0.82%.
news.conclusionZh: Anthropic上市消息带动科技股，美股三大指数周一收涨
news.whyEn: After a losing week on AI-spending worries, the rebound shows how sensitive markets remain to AI headlines ahead of big-tech earnings and the Fed decision.
news.whyZh: 上周AI担忧致美股下跌，本周反弹显示市场对AI消息高度敏感
news.detailEn: The Dow added 146 points, or 0.28%, to 52,361.58, while the Nasdaq Composite closed at 26,169.38. Gains were broad, with tech leading after Anthropic's S-1 rekindled enthusiasm for AI. A pullback in oil prices also helped sentiment. Investors now face a heavy week with the Fed decision and earnings from Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon and others.
news.detailZh: 道指涨146点（0.28%）至52,361.58点，纳指收于26,169.38点。涨势较为普遍，科技股领涨，Anthropic的招股书重新点燃了AI热情。油价回落也提振了情绪。本周市场还将迎来美联储决议以及微软、谷歌母公司、亚马逊等巨头财报。

news.titleEn: Fed decision: What to expect from October rate-setting meeting
news.conclusionEn: The Fed is widely expected to hold rates at 3.75%–4% when its meeting ends on Oct. 28, after hiking last month for the first time since 2023.
news.conclusionZh: 美联储料于10月28日维持利率3.75%-4%不变
news.whyEn: With oil above $100 fueling inflation fears, any hint of another hike would hit stocks, bonds and the dollar worldwide.
news.whyZh: 油价破百推高通胀担忧，任何再加息暗示都会冲击全球股债汇
news.detailEn: Traders price in more than a 90% chance of no change this week, but many economists expect at least one more hike by year-end. The Fed raised rates by 25 basis points in September, its first increase since 2023, as energy prices pushed inflation higher. Markets will focus on the statement and press conference for signals on the timing of the next move. A weak September jobs report has complicated the outlook.
news.detailZh: 交易员认为本周按兵不动的概率超过90%，但不少经济学家预计年底前至少还会加息一次。由于能源价格推高通胀，美联储9月加息25个基点，为2023年以来首次加息。市场将关注声明和发布会中关于下次行动时点的信号。9月就业数据疲软也让前景更复杂。

news.titleEn: Oil ticks lower as Saudi defense minister meets with Iran's president in Tehran to de-escalate
news.conclusionEn: Oil eased on Monday as Saudi Arabia's defense minister held de-escalation talks in Tehran; Brent settled at $115.81 after briefly topping $117.
news.conclusionZh: 沙特防长赴德黑兰斡旋降温，布伦特原油小幅回落
news.whyEn: Oil above $100 is driving inflation and rate-hike fears globally; any Saudi–Iran thaw could ease the supply risk premium.
news.whyZh: 高油价推升全球通胀，沙伊缓和可能压低供应风险溢价
news.detailEn: Prince Khalid bin Salman met Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, with Pakistan's army chief and Turkey's intelligence head also taking part. The talks come as Iran-allied Houthis keep attacking Saudi airports and energy sites. U.S. crude fell $1.51 to $101.76. Brent had gained about 6% last week, so traders remain wary of fresh supply shocks if diplomacy stalls.
news.detailZh: 沙特国防大臣哈立德亲王会见伊朗总统佩泽希齐扬，巴基斯坦陆军参谋长和土耳其情报首脑也参与会谈。会谈背景是亲伊朗的胡塞武装持续袭击沙特机场和能源设施。美国原油下跌1.51美元至101.76美元。布伦特上周累计上涨约6%，若外交受挫，市场仍担心新的供应冲击。

news.titleEn: Saudi-led coalition says it struck Houthi missile facilities
news.conclusionEn: The Saudi-led coalition said it destroyed four Houthi ballistic missile launchers and five storage tunnels, while the Houthis claimed new strikes on Riyadh's airport and oil pumping stations.
news.conclusionZh: 沙特联军称摧毁胡塞导弹设施，胡塞称再袭利雅得机场
news.whyEn: The escalating Saudi–Houthi war threatens Saudi oil export routes and Gulf air travel, keeping energy prices elevated.
news.whyZh: 冲突升级威胁沙特石油出口通道和海湾航空，推高能源价格
news.detailEn: Coalition spokesman Turki al-Maliki said the strikes also hit a missile depot and aimed to cut Houthi supply lines. Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree claimed a ballistic missile hit King Khalid airport and drones struck oil pumping stations; Saudi Arabia has not confirmed damage. A Houthi strike on the airport earlier this month killed 13 people, the deadliest attack on the kingdom in over a decade. Yemen's 2022 truce collapsed last month.
news.detailZh: 联军发言人马利基称，此次打击还摧毁了一座导弹库，目的是切断胡塞补给线。胡塞发言人萨雷亚称弹道导弹击中哈立德国王机场、无人机袭击了输油泵站，沙特方面未确认受损。本月早些时候胡塞袭击该机场造成13人死亡，是十多年来沙特遭受的最致命袭击。也门2022年停火协议已于上月破裂。

news.titleEn: Israeli elections: What are the possible outcomes?
news.conclusionEn: Israelis vote on Oct. 27 for all 120 Knesset seats, with polls showing neither Netanyahu's bloc nor the opposition reaching a 61-seat majority.
news.conclusionZh: 以色列10月27日大选，两大阵营均难获议会过半
news.whyEn: The result will decide Netanyahu's political survival and shape Israel's approach to Gaza, Iran and the wider regional conflict.
news.whyZh: 结果决定内塔尼亚胡去留，并影响以色列对加沙、伊朗的政策
news.detailEn: It is the first election since the Oct. 7, 2023 attacks and the war that followed. Polls put the opposition bloc around 52 seats and Netanyahu's alliance around 50, with Palestinian-led parties holding a possible kingmaker role. Former army chief Gadi Eisenkot is seen as the main alternative prime minister. Outcomes range from another Netanyahu coalition to a rotation deal, minority government or even fresh elections.
news.detailZh: 这是2023年10月7日袭击及随后战争以来的首次大选。民调显示反对派阵营约52席、内塔尼亚胡阵营约50席，巴勒斯坦人政党可能成为关键少数。前总参谋长艾森科特被视为最有力的总理替代人选。结果可能是内塔尼亚胡再次组阁、轮值总理、少数派政府，甚至重新大选。

news.titleEn: 20th CPC Central Committee starts fifth plenary session
news.conclusionEn: China's Communist Party opened its four-day fifth plenum in Beijing on Oct. 26, focused on strengthening party discipline and self-governance.
news.conclusionZh: 中共二十届五中全会10月26日在京开幕，聚焦全面从严治党
news.whyEn: The plenum sets the political tone ahead of the 2027 party congress; investors are watching for any signals on economic policy.
news.whyZh: 会议为2027年党代会定调，投资者关注是否释放经济政策信号
news.detailEn: Xi Jinping delivered a work report on behalf of the Politburo and explained a draft decision on strengthening full and rigorous party self-governance. The session runs from Oct. 26 to 29. Unlike some past plenums, the agenda centers on discipline and loyalty rather than economic planning. Markets hoping for growth support will look to the closing communique and later policy meetings.
news.detailZh: 习近平代表中央政治局作工作报告，并就关于坚定不移推进全面从严治党若干重大问题的决定稿作说明。会议于10月26日至29日举行。与部分以往全会不同，本次议程聚焦纪律和忠诚，而非经济规划。期待稳增长政策的市场将关注会议公报及后续政策会议。

news.titleEn: IMF wants China to spend its way out of the 'fiscal cliff'
news.conclusionEn: The IMF is urging Beijing to expand fiscal spending in the near term to reflate the economy, as China's combined fiscal spending fell 3.5% in the first eight months.
news.conclusionZh: IMF敦促中国短期扩大财政支出，摆脱「财政悬崖」
news.whyEn: Weak Chinese demand drags on global commodity prices and exporters; a bigger stimulus would ripple through Asia and resource economies like Australia.
news.whyZh: 中国内需疲弱拖累全球大宗和出口国，刺激力度影响亚洲和澳洲
news.detailEn: Nomura has called the spending decline a "true fiscal cliff" after 3.6% growth last year. The IMF says general government debt is about 68.4% of GDP, but augmented debt including local financing vehicles is around 126.6%. Local land-sale income has more than halved since 2021 to 4.2 trillion yuan. The IMF wants a medium-term framework that allows near-term stimulus while restoring debt sustainability later.
news.detailZh: 野村称，在去年增长3.6%之后，今年支出下滑是「真正的财政悬崖」。IMF估计中国一般政府债务约占GDP的68.4%，但计入地方融资平台等的广义债务约达126.6%。地方土地出让收入自2021年以来减少一半以上，降至4.2万亿元。IMF建议建立中期财政框架，短期刺激、中期恢复债务可持续。

news.titleEn: Zelenskyy says peace talks with Russia, US to restart
news.conclusionEn: Zelenskyy said Ukraine, Russia and the US will restart trilateral peace talks, planned for the first half of November in Abu Dhabi.
news.conclusionZh: 泽连斯基称乌俄美三方和谈将于11月上旬重启
news.whyEn: Progress toward a ceasefire would affect European energy, defense spending and Russia-related sanctions and commodity flows.
news.whyZh: 停火进展将影响欧洲能源、军费以及对俄制裁和大宗商品流向
news.detailEn: Moscow and Kyiv have both confirmed the next round is planned in the United Arab Emirates. Zelenskyy said technical negotiations should start as early as possible. Expectations are low, as Russia still demands large parts of Ukrainian territory and a pledge not to join NATO. The talks follow recent U.S. envoy meetings with Vladimir Putin.
news.detailZh: 莫斯科和基辅均已确认下一轮谈判将在阿联酋举行。泽连斯基表示技术性谈判应尽早开始。外界期望不高，因为俄罗斯仍要求乌克兰割让大片领土并承诺不加入北约。此次谈判紧随美国特使近期与普京的会晤。

businessTips.explanationEn: A take-or-pay contract obliges the buyer to pay for a minimum quantity of a product or service whether or not it actually uses it. Suppliers like it because it guarantees revenue that justifies big upfront investments, such as power plants, pipelines or data centers. For buyers it locks in supply and often a better price, but it turns a variable cost into a fixed liability. Reading these commitments is key to understanding a company's real risk.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「照付不议」合同要求买方无论是否实际使用，都必须为最低数量的产品或服务付款。供应商喜欢这种合同，因为稳定的收入能支撑电厂、管道、数据中心等大额前期投资。买方则锁定了供应，往往还拿到更优价格，但代价是把可变成本变成了固定负债。看懂这类承诺，才能看清一家公司的真实风险。
businessTips.exampleEn: Anthropic's S-1 discloses about $417 billion in future compute obligations — commitments it must honor even if demand slows. Similarly, an LNG importer signing a 20-year take-or-pay deal must pay for cargoes even when gas prices crash.
businessTips.exampleZh: Anthropic招股书披露约4170亿美元的未来算力支付承诺——即使需求放缓也必须履行。同样，签了20年照付不议合同的LNG进口商，即使气价暴跌也要为货物付款。

businessTips.explanationEn: Usage-based pricing charges customers according to how much they actually consume — per API call, per gigabyte, per minute — instead of a flat subscription. It lowers the barrier to trying your product, because small users pay little, and revenue grows automatically as customers succeed. The downside is less predictable monthly income. Many founders combine a small base fee with usage charges to get both stability and upside.
businessTips.explanationZh: 按用量计费是根据客户实际消耗收费——按调用次数、按流量、按分钟——而不是固定订阅费。它降低了试用门槛，小客户付得少；客户业务做大，你的收入也自动增长。缺点是每月收入不太好预测。很多创业者会采用「低额基础费+用量费」的组合，兼顾稳定和增长空间。
businessTips.exampleEn: About 80% of Anthropic's first-half revenue came from consumption-based billing. On a smaller scale, a freelancer offering an AI transcription tool could charge $0.10 per audio minute with a $5 monthly minimum, so occasional users stay while heavy users pay more.
businessTips.exampleZh: Anthropic上半年约80%的收入来自按用量计费。小规模来看，做AI转写工具的个人开发者可以按每分钟音频0.1美元收费、每月最低5美元，这样偶尔用的人留得住，重度用户贡献更多收入。

businessTips.explanationEn: A dual-class structure gives different share classes unequal voting rights, letting founders keep control even after selling most of the economic ownership to the public. Supporters say it protects long-term strategy from short-term market pressure. Critics say it weakens accountability, since outside shareholders can't easily replace management. Investors should check who controls the votes before buying, and whether there is a sunset clause that ends the special rights.
businessTips.explanationZh: 双重股权结构让不同类别的股票拥有不同的投票权，创始人即使把大部分经济权益卖给公众，也能保留控制权。支持者认为这能保护长期战略不受短期市场压力影响；批评者认为这削弱了问责，外部股东很难更换管理层。买入前应弄清谁掌握投票权，以及是否设有让特殊权利到期失效的「日落条款」。
businessTips.exampleEn: In Anthropic's filing, one Class F share held by a founders' entity carries 50.1% of total voting power, making it a "controlled company" under Nasdaq rules. Alphabet and Meta use similar structures, which is why their founders still steer strategy despite owning a minority of shares.
businessTips.exampleZh: Anthropic的申请文件中，创始人实体持有的一股F类股拥有50.1%的总投票权，按纳斯达克规则属于「受控公司」。Alphabet和Meta也采用类似结构，所以创始人虽只持少数股份，仍主导公司战略。
